name: Explore
summary: Pick a place, press Play: hear how its ozone, carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides or rain changes over time.
author: moran
description: Pick a dataset with the Data menu (ozone, carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides from NASA's GEOS-CF model, or IMERG rain): the map shows it and you hear only it, on its own recorded instrument and pitch range (carbon monoxide cello low, ozone flute in the middle, nitrogen oxides koto higher, rain marimba). Higher values play higher notes. Click, tap or use the arrow keys to pick a place (hovering only announces), then press Play: the map animates and the place's value plays as a melody, one note per hour. With no place picked, Play uses New Delhi.
